notes.title: CUTIES DUNGEON 2.0 Now Live!
notes.content:
CUTIE'S DUNGEON 2.0 UPDATE!

What's new:

 Fixed Hit boxes
 Visual tell when bosses are about to attack (except Sophia)
 NewGame+ Added story and difficulty (If Cutie is in the party)
 Alternative Ending has been added.
 More Dialogue from the Shopkeeper
 Soundtrack is now available on steam.
 And more...


Get The Cuties Dungeon Soundtrack Here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1188500/Cuties_Dungeon__Soundtrack/

Be sure to check out the cursed items here:
http://true-nightmare.com/games/CutiesDungeon/CURSED%20ITEMS%20INFORMATION%20LIST.pdf

Or check out the Cuties Dungeon homepage on our website:
